snippet.title: Whisper Mountain Outbreak - Early Access Trailer | Available Now!
snippet.description:
Whisper Mountain Outbreak is now available as Early Access on Steam!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953230/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak/

Escape room meets survival horror!

Enter Whisper Mountain Outbreak — a PvE survival game set in a remote town haunted by ancient supernatural forces. As a secret government agent, explore cursed locations, solve challenging puzzles, and battle terrifying creatures. Choose your specialization, manage resources, and uncover the dark mystery beneath Mount Bisik. Will your team survive the outbreak... or be consumed by it?

Now available on Steam!
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1953230/Whisper_Mountain_Outbreak/
